text: Tasya Vos is an assassin who [slips her mind into other people through a brain implant|threat|being taken over], carries out the hit, then forces her host to shoot himself so she can return home. Between jobs, thoughts of violence follow her to bed with her husband Michael and to her son Ira's bedside, and her handler Girder wants [those ties cut|wants|power over others]. Inside Colin Tate, fiancé of a wealthy CEO's daughter, the job goes wrong, and Vos finds she can neither leave nor overpower [the man whose body she wears|rules|it gets inside you].
